public_rationale: The retrieved industry research confirms that announced capacity and capacity under construction are different measures. It does not verify the claimed 50% tenant share. The apparent source trail leads partly to Zitron's own calculations and a reported private clarification, neither of which independently settles his assertion. Without a matched April inventory and contractual exposure evidence, neither the numerical share nor the stated scale of systemic risk can be scored.
limitations: Later construction inventories cannot substitute for the April snapshot.
Capacity commitments do not by themselves prove physical construction or unprotected financial exposure.
The result remains unresolved under either a capacity-share or project-count reading.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI and Anthropic account for 50% of AI data centers under construction, a systemic weakness if either cannot pay.

statement.excerpt: It’s also unclear whether the customer base for AI compute exists outside of OpenAI and Anthropic, whose demand accounts for 50% of AI data centers under construction, creating a massive systemic weakness if either of them lacks the money to pay.
statement.document_title: AI's Economics Don't Make Sense [Ad Free]

from_speaker: a massive systemic weakness if either of them lacks the money to pay
our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion uses gigawatts, so the primary reading is share of capacity under construction, rather than share of buildings.
The observation concerns the construction inventory current in April 2026 through publication. Projects merely announced and capacity already operating are excluded.
No geography is specified; I read the claim as global rather than silently restricting it to the United States.
The payment-risk clause asserts exposure to customer concentration. It does not predict that either company will actually default.
The hedged statement about whether other customers exist is not converted into a categorical claim that there are no other customers.
criteria.support_condition: A matched April construction inventory shows approximately half of relevant AI capacity attributable to OpenAI and Anthropic demand, with contractual or financing evidence of material exposure if either cannot pay.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A comparable and sufficiently complete April inventory places their combined share materially away from half, or evidence establishes that the asserted payment exposure is materially insulated.
